name: Cosmos-Reason2-8B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct: 36 full GQA layers (kv heads 8, head_dim 128) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-23. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, not a new base model: same config.json, same 8.767 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence other, repo created 2025-12-12.
